{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", trial_df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id']).sum())

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Confirm we now have one row per patient
print("Rows after deduplication:", len(trial_df))

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_severe"}
